findings.title: Contractual penalty is not the sole remedy for delay
findings.deviation: Clause 8.4 provides that contractual penalties are credited against general damages claims for delay, allowing the Client to claim actual damages beyond the penalty.
findings.impact: AtliQ could face additional damages claims for delay beyond the agreed 5% milestone delay penalty cap.
findings.quote: The contractual penalty shall be credited against any claim for damages for the same delay.
findings.counterPosition: Specify that the contractual penalty is Supplier's sole and exclusive remedy for delay and that total liability for delay is limited to the penalty amount.

findings.title: Confidentiality obligations extend for 5 years post-termination
findings.deviation: Clause 11.3 specifies a 5-year post-termination confidentiality obligation, whereas AtliQ's playbook standard is a 2–3 year term.
findings.impact: AtliQ will remain subject to confidentiality restrictions for longer than standard policy requires.
findings.quote: The confidentiality obligation shall continue for five (5) years after termination of this Agreement.
findings.counterPosition: Reduce the confidentiality duration to 2 or 3 years post-termination.

fine.note: Aggregate liability capped at 1x total remuneration with standard statutory carve-outs.
Indemnification is mutual and applies to third-party claims arising from culpable breach.
AtliQ retains background IP (PipeKit) with a non-exclusive licence granted, while custom deliverables transfer upon full payment.
Termination for convenience ensures payment for services rendered and committed costs.
Acceptance terms include a 10 working day review window, deemed acceptance, and minor defect protections.
12-month warranty period with standard cure options complies with standard playbook terms.
Data protection terms require execution of a DPA and EU SCCs for cross-border processing.
No non-compete, non-solicit, or exclusivity restrictions imposed on AtliQ.
No unpermitted set-off mechanisms or rights across unrelated agreements.
No unachievable or unverified insurance requirements specified.
